info.title: PirateTalk optional feature extension
info.description: Core-owned contract foundation; routes are not mounted by task1. Same canonical room identities, same bearer middleware and SendGate, no new provider or SSE. Discovery 404 is canonical-only; 401 is auth failure. Incompatible/malformed discovery disables optional actions with diagnostic. Reconnect may rediscover; no polling.

Id.description: Positive signed 64-bit decimal ID, no leading zero. Maximum 9223372036854775807; range enforced by generated semantic boundary.

RoomId.description: Signed 64-bit nonzero decimal room identity, preserved from canonical core. No leading zero or plus; range enforced by semantic boundary.

Cursor.description: Opaque account/room/filter/snapshot-bound scan cursor; invalid or mismatched cursor is 400. Advance on scanned messages even when items is empty.

TextSend.description: Mention start/length are UTF-16 code units in text, must be in bounds at scalar boundaries, nonoverlapping, and server checks membership before converting native offsets.

StickerId.description: Catalog pack item code plus one-based sticker index, separated by colon; not a pack list position.

Confirmed.description: Only attributable native readback; never inferred from ret 0x1 or HTTP acceptance.

MutationResponse.description: Do not automatically retry once bytes may have been sent; retain draft/pending state. Unknown error code remains an error.

ReadResponse.description: Durable local overlay only; no recipient receipt and no native activation. Rejected/unconfirmed use MutationResponse error branches.

UnixSeconds.description: Inclusive Unix seconds, not milliseconds. Retained i64 validators have no fixed duration maximum; wire values restricted to JS safe integers. from <= to. No row cap may silently truncate a selected period.

model.description: Must match a model returned by authenticated discovery; validated against configured server allowlist.
Must match a model returned by authenticated discovery; validated against configured server allowlist.

file.description: One raw multipart file, 1..67108864 bytes; metadata not accepted as bytes. This is an extension ingress cap, not a retained native uploader limit.

UploadResponse.description: Opaque account+room-bound single-file staging token, not native send or proof of upload delivery. Reject expired/wrong-room tokens before native IPC; release staged bytes on cancellation/expiry. Raster photo and video classifications follow retained extensions; other files are download-only, never executable inline content.

HistoryRequest.description: messageId loads context around exact anchor. beforeId, messageId and cursor are mutually exclusive.

StickerResourceResponse.description: Binary raster bytes with image/png, image/gif, image/webp or image/jpeg. No arbitrary external URL. A missing resource is a JSON error, never an empty successful image.

upload.meaning: No explicit size cap or MIME validator exists in retained send_media/upload_media_pure; 64 MiB here is the extension ingress policy, not inherited native evidence.

period.meaning: Retained summary accepts nonnegative ordered i64 timestamps and all; no fixed duration cap. Wire safe-integer bound is explicit. Question normalizes selected range; extension rejects inverted ranges instead.
